draft.shortGloss: to finish; to end; to complete
draft.emotion: satisfied and relieved, having finally completed a task
notes: Regular second-group (-ir) verb: plural forms take '-iss-' (nous finissons, vous finissez, ils finissent); past participle 'fini'.
Takes 'de' before an infinitive to mean 'to finish doing' (finir de manger), and 'par' to mean 'to end up doing' (finir par accepter).
